caseName: Schine Chain Theatres, Inc. v. United States
caseNameFull: Schine Chain Theatres, Inc. v. United States
attorneys: Willard S. McKay, Harold R. Medina, Arthur Garfield Hays and Osmond K. Fraenkel for appellants.

opinions.text:
Appeal from the *818District Court of the United States for the Western District of New York. The petition for rehearing is granted. The judgment entered December 16, 1946, ante, p. 686, is vacated and probable jurisdiction is noted.

Willard S. McKay, Harold R. Medina, Arthur Garfield Hays and Osmond K. Fraenkel for appellants. Mr. Justice Jackson took no part in the consideration or decision of this application.
